title: Remap object IDs during Payment Management FR data
summary: Payment Management FR now automatically remaps legacy report and xmlport IDs to their new equivalents when the app is activated, eliminating manual reconfiguration after upgrade.
key_points: Added RemapPaymentStepObjectIDs() method to remap legacy report and xmlport IDs in Payment Step FR records during upgrade
Built-in mapping covers standard Microsoft FR payment reports and xmlport, with zero values and unmapped IDs left untouched
New OnAfterRemapPaymentStepObjectIDs integration event allows partners to remap custom reports and xmlports
